rows.Title: Checkout button unresponsive on Safari 17
rows.Steps to reproduce:
1. Add any item to the cart
2. Open the cart in Safari 17
3. Tap Checkout; nothing happens.

rows.Title: Product images blurry on retina displays
rows.Steps to reproduce: Open any product page on a 2x display and compare with the Figma export.

rows.Title: App crashes when syncing 500+ items offline
rows.Steps to reproduce: Create more than 500 items offline, reconnect and wait for sync to start.

rows.Title: Push notifications arrive twice on Android 14
rows.Steps to reproduce: Register the same device twice by reinstalling without clearing the token.

rows.Title: Date picker ignores the user's locale
rows.Steps to reproduce: Switch the browser language to German and open the booking form.

rows.Title: Row counts differ after migration batch 4
rows.Steps to reproduce: Compare counts between the legacy table and the new fact table for 2023-Q4.

rows.Title: Welcome email links open the wrong page
rows.Steps to reproduce: Click 'Start learning' in the welcome email from a mobile client.

rows.Title: Rate limiting returns 500 instead of 429
rows.Steps to reproduce: Send more than 100 requests per minute from one API key.

rows.Title: Dashboard chart tooltips overlap
rows.Steps to reproduce: Hover two adjacent bars on a narrow viewport.

rows.Title: Invoice reminder runs twice at midnight
rows.Steps to reproduce: Check the automation log around the daylight-saving switch.

rows.Title: Logo SVG renders with a white background in dark mode
rows.Steps to reproduce: Open the brand guidelines page with a dark colour scheme.

rows.Title: Search suggestions are slow for long queries
rows.Steps to reproduce: Type more than 40 characters into the header search box.
